name: ModelVariant804_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant804_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (bolts charge on the caster, then fly with ribbon trails to jittered points on the opposing slot; on arrival each flares into a glow with two fans of rays and a burst of drifting sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and sparks and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 while charging and in flight, 1 once when the first bolt arrives, 2 once the first bolt has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-821 and 918 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
